text:
Both Gate 2 revisions have been applied and validated across `header.json`, `units-004.json`, and `units-005.json`:

1. **`project_checks` in `header.json`:**
   - Replaced `yarn test:other` and `yarn test:all` with `yarn test:typecheck`, `yarn test:code`, and `yarn test:app --watch=false`.

2. **Firebase room storage for pages (`FR-19`, `NFR-4`, `AC-12`):**
   - Added `U27` (`excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts`) to encrypt `{ elements, pages }` inside `FirebaseStoredScene.ciphertext` (with backward compatibility for legacy element-only payloads), track `pages` in `FirebaseSceneVersionCache` / `isSavedToFirebase`, reconcile `pages` via `reconcilePages` in `saveToFirebase`, and return `{ elements, pages }` from `saveToFirebase` and `loadFromFirebase`.
   - Updated `U28` (`excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx`) to pass `appState` to `isSavedToFirebase`, pass `storedScene.elements` and `storedScene.pages` from `saveToFirebase` to `handleRemoteSceneUpdate`, and restore `pages` from `loadFromFirebase` in `initializeRoom` so a room loaded from Firebase with no peers online preserves all pages and keeps every element on its own page.
   - Updated `U32` (`excalidraw-app/tests/pages.test.tsx`) to test saving and loading a multi-page room through `saveToFirebase` and `loadFromFirebase` with no peers online and verifying that elements on `page-1` and `page-2` stay on their respective pages.
